in_game_name: Fusion: Takes two unfused Level 3 balls and merges their properties into one ball.
text: Fusion: Takes two unfused Level 3 balls and merges their properties into one ball. This frees up an inventory slot.

claims.detail: blueprintedgaming restates the core fusion definition (properties merge; slot freed). Pair here is an arbitrary illustrative pair (schema requires a pair); the rule is general.

text: The endgame scaling trick: evolve your pairs first, then fuse the evolved balls together. Stacking two evolved movesets into a single ball is how you reach the damage numbers needed for NG+ runs.

claims.detail: blueprintedgaming endgame advice: evolve first, then fuse the two evolved balls so one ball carries two evolved movesets. General rule; pair is illustrative.

text: Fusions will usually combine the benefits of the status effects applied by one of the parent balls with the area of effect benefits of the other, which can result in chain reaction effects from, say, a ball with laser beam effects applying multiple instances of splash damage effects or bleed stacks across entire rows or columns at once.

claims.detail: TVTropes states the general composition rule: one parent's STATUS effect rides the other parent's AOE channel, producing chain reactions (laser-line AOE applying bleed stacks across whole rows/columns). Illustrative pair taken as Laser Beam + Bleed from the text; rule is general. This is the same idea as namu.wiki's 'Area attack + status abnormality = enemies hit in the range also suffer from status abnormality'.

text: 2種類のボールを融合し、能力をかけ合わせられる。組み合わせるボールの効果によっては火力や殲滅力を大幅に強化できる。融合の難易度は高いが、特に進化後のボール同士を融合させるのがおすすめだ。なお、融合後も装備はレベル3のままとなる。
